Oncology development relies heavily on first-in-human dose selection, complex biologics, targeted therapies, rare molecular subsets, basket/platform trials, and single pivotal datasets with confirmatory evidence. A regulator-level change to these evidence pathways can alter trial startup, study design, investment decisions, and how quickly investigational cancer therapies reach patients.

highlights.summary: Sunscreen is a cancer-prevention intervention. The effective order expands the ingredients manufacturers may use in US products and may improve formulation choice, but it does not by itself prove superior skin-cancer prevention or mean products are immediately available on shelves.

highlights.title: Gedatolisib + Fulvestrant
highlights.summary: FDA approved gedatolisib with fulvestrant, with or without palbociclib, for PIK3CA-wild-type HR-positive/HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer after endocrine progression, adding a large progression-free-survival gain in a setting where many patients have already exhausted first-line endocrine options.

highlights.title: Galleri-NHS negative screening signal
highlights.summary: This is a major cautionary signal for population blood-based multi-cancer screening. A negative primary endpoint should slow premature adoption and reshape how MCED claims are presented to payers and the public.
